dex.entry: A larger, more confident ore-rodent whose entire coat is threaded with conductive mineral filaments; static discharge is constant and audible as a faint hiss. Canon Cinderhead Mine kin. The sparking mine-rat everyone wants to catch; its crackling silhouette is instantly recognisable in the cave dark

art.silhouette: Medium-sized stout rodent; fur is dark grey-black with arcing amber-white spark threads woven through it; black iron-ore patches on shoulders and haunches; tail has two ore-bead segments that clatter together.
